Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the transition of residents of residential habilitation centers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to community housing; and adding a new section tochapter 71A.20 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 71A.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Prior to transitioning any resident of a residential habilitationcenter to community–based housing under the care or direction of thesecretary, the secretary must ensure the resident's housing meets theminimum requirements for housing quality standards as established bythe United States department of housing and urban development under 24C.F.R. Part 982.401 as it currently exists. The secretary is toconduct periodic inspections of such property to ensure the propertycontinues to meet these standards. The secretary is to maintain awritten checklist of all inspections.
